title: drynaria leiorhiza
intro: Drynaria leiorhiza, commonly known as Chinese club moss, is a type of fern native to Southeast Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cognitive function, and enhancing immune system function. The therapeutic actions of Drynaria leiorhiza include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as arthritis, Alzheimer's disease, and autoimmune disorders. The bioactive constituents of Drynaria leiorhiza include polysaccharides, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
